Subject: Hosted API eval — booked but need later window

Hi Sean,

Thanks — I just signed up via the hosted API trial and booked a 30-min eval for Nov 9 at 10:00 AM PT. I realized that conflicts with a cross-country sync on our side.

Is there any flexibility to move to a late-afternoon PST slot (4:00–5:00 PM PT) on Nov 9, or Nov 10 morning? Our team will want to see a quick sandbox walk-through and a short check on billing/quotas.

Attached is a short note on our evaluation goals.

Best,

[jordan.lim@acmeretail.com]

Hi Jordan — thanks for the heads up and for signing up. Happy to move things — 30 min should be enough for a focused sandbox run.

A couple of quick options that work for our onsite engineers and me (all PT):
- Nov 9, 4:15–4:45 PM PT
- Nov 9, 4:45–5:15 PM PT (if you need the later end)
- Nov 10, 9:30–10:00 AM PT

If you prefer, I can send a single updated invite — otherwise pick the slot that looks best. I cc'd Diego to confirm sandbox provisioning and to include any quick preflight steps.

I've attached a brief preflight checklist (what we typically ask customers to have ready) and will hold the original slot for one business day while we lock this in.

Thanks —
Sean

sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134
